recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. Future changes to this SearchParameter should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than the core FHIR checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-41308 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 change request reporting that http://hl7.org/fhir/extensions/SearchParameter-workflow-researchStudy.json used an expression rooted at CodeSystem.extension(...), even though CodeSystem was not a declared base and the expression therefore failed to cover the intended base resources.
initial_application: The SearchParameter was introduced in the FHIR Extension Pack by FHIR-39656 with the erroneous CodeSystem expression. Extension Pack commit f29a4db18daed5126a920228f81244fbe7bf9524 later changed the expression to DomainResource.extension('http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/workflow-researchStudy').value. No current core FHIR source commit or file applies this SearchParameter.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread identified CodeSystem as wrong and accepted a simplified resource-level expression. OO minutes on 2023-06-27 recorded the Persuasive disposition to update the SearchParameter to Resource.extension(...).value, and an OO R6 Extension Work page tracked FHIR-41308 on an Extension Pack branch as ready for QA. Core fhir.ini has active extension spreadsheets but no SearchParameter-workflow-researchStudy entry, and core searches only found OID/history or unrelated workflow-mapping references.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The authoritative current definition is in HL7/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/multiple/SearchParameter-workflow-researchStudy.xml and already uses DomainResource.extension(...).value across the declared DomainResource base resources.
